title: Andre Russell Breaks Silence On Why He Retired From IPL: 'I Don't Want To... | Cricket News - News18
text: All-rounder Andre Russell recently brought an end to his storied 13-year IPL career after announcing retirement from the T20 league. Russell spent 11 of his 13 seasons in IPL with Kolkata Knight Riders, during which he produced a series of memorable performances with the bat and the ball, while playing key roles in their two title triumphs in 2014 and 2024. Even though Russell is in the last phase of his glittering T20 career, he remains an in-demand player in the various leagues around the globe, including in IPL. However, in a surprise development, KKR released him before the IPL mini-auction, set to be held later this month. It was expected that Russell would trigger a bidding war between franchises, given his all-round capabilities. However, according to Cricbuzz , a desire to bid goodbye while he’s still “at the top" of his game and to finish his IPL career as a KKR player, led him to announce retirement. Explaining his surprising call, Russell cited the examples of legendary sprinter Usain Bolt and batting great AB de Villiers. “Take Usain Bolt, for example, or AB de Villiers. When those guys hung up their boots while still at the top of their game, a lot of fans were asking, “why?" When I made this decision, I felt it was the best decision for me at this point. I don’t want to fade out; I want to leave a legacy behind," Russell was quoted as saying by Cricbuzz . “I believe it’s best to retire when people still say “why" rather than reaching a stage where they say, “okay, yeah, you should have retired three or four years ago," he added. During his IPL career, Russell scored 2651 runs at a strike-rate of 174.17, while taking 123 wickets with his pace bowling. However, he will remain in the KKR camp, having been announced as their ‘Power Coach’. “To be honest, when I heard that name (Power Coach) coming from Mr Venky (Mysore), I said, ‘hmm, that describes Dre Russ perfectly, that describes Andre Russell’… because when it comes to what I’ve been doing on the field – the power that I possess when I bat, the energy that I show in the field with the ball in hand – I thought, yeah, this name sounds good," Russell explained. “I am happy to help in any department – whether it’s in the gym, whether it’s fitness, anything. I’m going to be there to make sure that any player who needs me to assist them with anything – I have the experience to do it. I think it suits me well," he added.
